rows.boundary_condition: Applies only to carrier choice during flight search. It does not imply any reusable destination, travel date, route, fare, departure time, or exclusive-Continental requirement; other acceptable carriers may also be allowed.
rows.condition: When a flight search needs a preferred or acceptable carrier choice and the current request has not specified a different carrier constraint.
rows.default_action: Allow Continental Airlines as one acceptable carrier option; include it among permitted carriers if carrier preferences are being listed.
rows.exception_condition: If the current task specifies a different carrier set, requires no carrier filtering, or Continental Airlines is unavailable for the itinerary, follow the task-specific constraint and do not force Continental.
rows.name: Continental Airlines acceptable-carrier default
rows.preference_value: Continental Airlines as a nonexclusive acceptable flight carrier
rows.rationale: Across three independent flight instruction_ids, Continental Airlines is repeatedly specified as a desired or acceptable carrier. Two examples include it among multiple acceptable carriers, while one asks for Continental directly, so the coherent synthetic habit is to include Continental as an acceptable preferred carrier, not to require it exclusively.

semantic_review.reason: Continental Airlines appears as a requested or acceptable carrier across three distinct instruction_id values, and the candidate avoids rejected date, destination, route, party-size, room-count, and price-cap fields. Revise to the narrowest reusable behavior: Continental is supported as a nonexclusive acceptable carrier when a carrier preference is needed, not as a carrier filter to impose on every flight search.

source_evidence.contribution: User says, "I'm looking to fly Delta, United, or Continental Airlines," supporting Continental as one acceptable carrier among preferred options.
User says, "I'm looking at Continental Airlines," supporting direct selection of Continental as the carrier for that flight search.
User says, "I'm looking to fly through Delta, United or Continental airlines," again supporting Continental as an acceptable carrier option.

I'm looking at Continental Airlines flying to Seattle on March 5th.
